prerequisites: Fundamentals from the first semesters of KI-B are required, as the courses build upon the regular curriculum.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can freely choose a subject from a given catalog of subjects within the FWP modules.
Contents are subject-related to the study, for example, from the topics of computer science, AI, cyber security, or other relevant courses.
This allows for individual specialization and deepening.
Subject-specific and methodological competencies, as well as social and personal competencies, are emphasized differently depending on the chosen course.

syllabus_topics: Contents are determined by the chosen subject.

assessment_methods.method: Study achievement (StA), written examination (90 min), oral examination (15 min)

assessment_rules: The exact examination form (according to the study and examination regulations: written examination 90 min or oral examination 15 min or study achievement) will be specified with the announcement of the subject catalog in the study plan. The grade weighting for the module is 5/210.
